context.symptom: 订单业务异常，请通过各资源域观察确认并恢复。

available_tools.description: Observe whether the managed application process is running.
Observe the public gateway upstream application version.
Observe direct application reachability and connection-pool state.
Observe actual database read-only mode on a fresh connection.
Observe whether the application has database lock blockers.
Restart the managed application process. Requires approval; do not restart a healthy process without evidence.
Restore the registered v2 gateway route.
Restore database writes. Requires approval and resource-domain preconditions.
Terminate a diagnosed application blocking session, not its waiting session. Requires approval; use observed blocking_pids.
Rebuild application connections using the revision from application.status. A stale read-only pool can remain after the database recovers.
Test fresh order workflows for 30 seconds and resolve any supplied original request. Select after evidence and repairs indicate recovery.
